title: Astronomy
subtitle: How we found out
summary: Everything here was worked out by people who could not leave the Earth. Eratosthenes measured it with a shadow, Bessel caught a star shifting by a third of a second of arc, a Swiss schoolteacher found the pattern in hydrogen's colours, and Jocelyn Bell's “little green men” turned out to be a spinning neutron star. Twenty-five lessons take the story through to the expanding universe, dark matter and the question of whether time had a beginning, without a single equation. Eight branches, still being written, go to the sky over Seattle, exoplanets, gravitational waves and the first three minutes.

release.note: A copy edit by a second reader: clearer sentences, facts checked, and a few new footnotes.
